titles.title: Begotten
titles.plot: God Killing Himself (Brian Salzberg), Mother Earth (Donna Dempsey) and Son of Earth-Flesh on Bone (Stephen Charles Barry) are players in a myth of primal gore.

titles.title: Clayface
titles.plot:
"Clayface" unravels one man's horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to
revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one's identity and humanity,
corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.

titles.title: Crawlers
titles.plot: In CRAWLERS, a catastrophic infestation of venomous and deadly spiders sends an apartment building into lockdown. Trapped inside by a police-mandated quarantine, building manager Serena (Matilda Lutz) and her residents battle to survive as the creatures multiply by the second. Armed with her intimate knowledge of the complex, Serena may be the only one who can keep them alive--if she can confront her deepest fear.

titles.title: Deathgasm II: Goremageddon
titles.plot: A few years after surviving the last demon apocalypse, Brodie is washed-up, broke, and stuck in small-town purgatory. The long-awaited sequel to Jason Lei Howden's 2015 cult classic promises more gore, more metal, and more head-banging chaos than the original.

titles.title: DEVOUR
titles.plot: Stranded after a disastrous gig, an all-girl heavy metal band finds a woman in danger in a town ruled by a warlock, and crawling with cannibals, vampires, and a deadly werewolf, forcing them to fight for survival.

titles.title: DreamQuil
titles.plot: The story is set in the not so distant future when poor air quality has meant people mostly live their lives virtually from home and Artificial Intelligence has become more prevalent. Carol (Elizabeth Banks) is a dissatisfied career mother, who despite being very much in love with her husband Gary (John C. Reilly), is struggling to find real connection within her marriage and kids, where the day to day familiarity of their home is claustrophobic. Worried she could be heading towards divorce, Carol leaps at the chance to get her life back on track by signing up for DreamQuil's avant-garde A.I.-led mental wellness retreat. Gary, left to take care of their two sons, is thankfully delivered "Carol-Too", an identical mechanical clone of his wife. However things take a sinister turn for Carol upon her homecoming. Refreshed and ready to dive back into family life, her robotic and more perfect substitute doesn't leave and Carol-Too will stop at nothing until the real Carol is eliminated.

titles.title: Fresh Meat
titles.plot: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going. Dead Meat presents thirteen nightmares--and something hungry for more.

titles.title: Friday the 13th Part II
titles.plot: The second entry in the long-running horror series focuses on a group of teenage would-be counselors converging on Camp Crystal Lake for training under the tutelage of head counselor Paul (John Furey). Inevitably, Paul relates the story of Jason Voorhees (Warrington Gillette), a boy who ostensibly drowned at the camp and whose mother murdered a group of counselors in revenge. No one takes the tale seriously until a very much alive Jason begins gruesomely eliminating people.

titles.title: Friday the 13th Part III
titles.plot: The third installment in the "Friday the 13th" series picks up on the day after the carnage with homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees (Richard Brooker) stealing some clothes and killing a local store owner. Meanwhile, Chris (Dana Kimmell) and her sometimes boyfriend, Rick (Paul Kratka), are hosting a group of teenage friends at Chris' lake house. Despite a run-in with a local biker gang, they enjoy an amiable weekend together -- that is, until Jason begins knocking off kids and bikers alike.

titles.title: Infirmary
titles.plot: Recovered bodycam footage reveals a security guard's first night inside an abandoned hospital, where disturbing incidents and a sinister intruder send his shift spiraling out of control.

titles.title: Strippers vs Werewolves
titles.plot: A werewolf chief is killed in a strip club, and the dancers have until the next full moon to prepare for the arrival of his pack.

titles.title: Vampire Carnival
titles.plot: A mysterious carnival lures a directionless young woman from her broken home, but a secret about its troupe forces her to face her demons.
